children: Tortoise Energy Infrastructure established an at-the-market (ATM) equity program to sell up to 2,500,000 common shares under its shelf registration. The company signed a distribution agreement with Pine Distributors, which will act as sales agent, and Pine appointed UBS Securities as a sub-placement agent to support execution. The ATM structure enables the company to raise equity opportunistically over time, enhancing financial flexibility and market access.
